$comment: Hard gzip budgets in KiB for bundled+minified ESM with optional peers externalized. These are release limits, not generated baselines. Aggregate compatibility-entry ceilings include roving selection grids, projected-content isolation, light-DOM announcements, standard error chrome, focus continuity, media lifecycle state transfer, defensive value normalization, bounded rendered-data alternatives, vetoable layout transitions, iframe theme-state restoration, transitive autoloader peer metadata, cross-component focus-visible and disabled-hover guards, declaration-order CSS corrections, and matching JSDoc. Additional opt-in capability covers per-box lr-box-plot keyboard/pointer interactivity, the shared forced-colors chart encoding used by lr-box-plot and lr-lite-chart, lr-xml-viewer host-supplied highlights, lr-context-meter's legend, lr-node-palette reordering, lr-retrieval-results custom grouping, lr-terminal compact/frame chrome, and host focus/blur/click forwarding across five media components. Aggregate compatibility entries and the two family ceilings carrying most of that implementation weight (agent-tools and retrieval) move; every per-component, percentile, and other family ceiling stays unchanged. The resulting ceilings are about 4% above the measured build. The conversation family ceiling moves from 310 to 325 because lr-code-block and lr-markdown regain per-component messages after the default-string slice generator learned the bare-identifier `localize(key)` call shape used by shared helper modules, in addition to the family's Shiki dark-theme wiring. The button canary moves from 31 to 33 in 9.0.0 for the settable-`rel` merge: `rel` is a reflected property and `resolvedRel` strips `opener` while force-adding the target-derived guard. This makes wa-button, sl-button, wa-breadcrumb-item, and sl-breadcrumb-item mechanically migratable and reduces `warning-required` from 13 to 9. The entry remains deliberately tight because it is the foreign-dependency canary, not a general growth allowance.
